policy.decision: Person Domain v2 Review Unit 04. Reclassify one bounded 12-Person ancient humanities/philosophy slice from legacy knowledge to culture. Every write requires live Production previous_domain=knowledge; any drift fails closed.

review_scope.selection_rule: Select twelve current Production knowledge Persons whose representative identity is clearly philosophy, historiography, grammar/philology, or an ancient philosophical school, avoiding the harder science/philosophy boundary cases Pythagoras, Aristotle, and Hippocrates for a later focused review.

entries.basis: V2 culture includes philosophy and humanities. Confucius is globally represented as a foundational East Asian thinker, teacher, and philosopher; political office is secondary to his intellectual and cultural legacy.

V2 culture includes philosophy and social thought. Mozi is the foundational figure of Mohism, an early Chinese philosophical movement centered on ethics, political thought, argumentation, and standards of judgment.
V2 culture includes history and historiography. Herodotus is represented above all as a historian and author of the Histories, not as a natural/formal scientist.
V2 culture includes history and historiography. Thucydides is represented by the History of the Peloponnesian War and his historiographical method; his generalship does not outweigh that legacy.
V2 culture includes philosophy. Socrates is one of the canonical founders of the Western philosophical tradition and is represented by philosophical inquiry rather than science or political office.
V2 culture includes language, philology, and humanities. Pāṇini is represented by the Aṣṭādhyāyī and the systematic analysis and codification of Sanskrit grammar.
V2 culture includes philosophy and humanities. Plato is one of the central figures in the history of philosophy and is represented by his philosophical writings and Academy.
V2 culture includes philosophy. Diogenes is the central emblematic figure of Cynic philosophy, remembered for philosophical ethics and critique of convention.
V2 culture includes philosophy. Arete succeeded Aristippus as head of the Cyrenaic school and belongs to the philosophical succession of the Cyrenaics.
V2 culture includes philosophy and literature. Zhuangzi is a pivotal figure of Classical philosophical Daoism whose eponymous text is both philosophically and literarily foundational.
V2 culture includes philosophy and social thought. Mencius is a canonical Confucian philosopher known for ethical and political philosophy and theories of human nature.

V2 culture includes history and historiography. Sima Qian is represented by the Shiji and his foundational role in Chinese historiography; court astronomical duties are secondary to that enduring historical identity.
